Wild Magic: Unleash, when activated, summons either an Energizing or Revitalizing Chaotic Storm for 2 minutes. Anyone standing within the storm may be affected by either Energizing Chaotic Magic I or Revitalizing Chaotic Magic I. Energizing Chaotic Magic I restores 1% mana and endurance while draining 2% health every 6 seconds and upon landing. Revitalizing Chaotic Magic I drains 0.2% mana and endurance while restoring 2% health every 6 seconds and upon landing. Both spells also grant your melee attacks and damaging spells a chance to unleash Chaotic Strike I upon your target, dealing 40000 chromatic damage. Each of these effects grows more powerful the longer you remain within the storm.
